visual.general_description: Five-panel composite of cytogenetic and molecular images: two G-banded karyotypes, two FISH images and a Sanger sequencing electropherogram, with panel letters A to E printed on the image.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (top left) and panel D (middle left) are grayscale G-banded karyotypes arranged under labels 1 to 22, X and Y. Panel B (top right) is a dark-background fluorescence image of blue-stained nuclei with red spots and two white arrows. Panel C (middle) is a row of three Sanger electropherogram segments with WT and MUT base rows, black arrows and printed variant labels. Panel E (bottom right) is a grayscale metaphase spread with small red and green fluorescent signals. No patient names, identifiers, dates or institution text are visible.

panels.general_description: G-banded karyotype image with chromosomes arranged by number, panel letter A at the top left.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale G-banded chromosomes are arranged in numbered groups under printed labels 1 to 22, X and Y. Each label sits under its group of banded chromosomes; the group under the label Y position is empty. The group at label 8 and some other groups appear to hold more than two chromosomes, but the individual copy count in every group cannot be reliably counted at this resolution. No scale bar, text other than the numeric labels, or patient text is visible.

panels.general_description: Three Sanger sequencing electropherogram segments with colored peaks, wild-type and mutant base rows, black arrows and printed variant labels, panel letter C at the top left.
panels.detailed_description: Three side-by-side electropherogram segments show overlapping colored peaks in green, blue, red and black. Above each segment, two rows of colored base letters are labeled WT and MUT. Dashed rectangles outline the variant region in the second and third segments, and a black arrow points at the variant position in each of the three segments. Printed labels beneath the segments read c.1772dup p.Y591*, rs6057581 (c.3973C>A p.L1325F) and rs79865730 (c.1965 C>T p.T655T). Small position numbers appear above the traces.
